title: ZSTD / best_compression rationale
body: Switching the warm-tier codec to best_compression (ZSTD-based) trades a small amount of CPU on infrequent warm-tier reads for meaningfully lower storage footprint. Because HOT-tier indices keep the default codec, query latency on actively-queried data is unaffected — the trade only applies to data that has already rolled past the HOT phase.
